text:
olivia: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp hit a puzzler. Using node-sdk v0.9 with the batching helper hitting /v1/embeddings (rerank model). Got vectors of length 512 but our retriever expects 768. Any quick ideas?

sam: can you share the minimal request + response (trim floats ok)? also any headers like x-redwood-model-variant?

olivia: minimal request:
```js
client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'redwood/rerank-1',
  input: ['p1','p2','p3'],
  batch_size: 3,
  retry: { max_attempts: 2 }
})
```
response (trimmed floats):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/rerank-1",
  "embeddings": [[0.01,...,0.12],[0.02,...,0.11],[0.03,...,0.10]],
  "embedding_dim": 512
}
```
I only noticed because similarity scores were broken.

maria: weird. Could be a fallback/variant (compact) being returned on retry. Do you have raw headers?

olivia: headers show x-redwood-model-variant: rerank-1-compact and x-retry-count: 1. Oops.

kai: ah that explains dims. The Node batching helper has a default fallback model for throttles to a cheaper variant. Looks like the default was set to rerank-1-compact (512-d).

ben: yep i merged a small change to add cost-tier fallbacks last sprint and forgot to land the variant-metadata propagation. The helper also normalizes/assumes dims match the requested model which fails when a compact variant returns shorter vectors.

sam: so this is an SDK parity and config gotcha — do Python/Go SDKs behave the same?

jess: Python is safe here — it uses the config key model_fallback (different name) and we didn't set a default there. So only node sampleapp surfaced it. SDK parity gap confirmed.

olivia: temporary workaround for customers?

ben: for now set retry: { fallback_model: null } on the call to disable implicit fallback, or set retry: { fallback_model: 'rerank-1' } to force the same model. We'll push a patch to: 1) remove implicit fallback default in node helper, 2) expose response.model_variant containing x-redwood-model-variant, and 3) add a sampleapp check to validate vector length before downstream use.

kai: small suggestion — add a preflight assertion in sampleapp: if (response.embeddings[0].length !== expectedDim) throw or log and re-request. Put it in onboarding checklist.

doc-bot: Created internal task DEVEX-4321 and PR #5801 for node batching helper fixes. Deploy job queued.

sam: once merged we should update onboarding quickstart with a short note: "Why embedding dims can change (model variant fallback) and how to assert dims."

jess: also flag platform to include x-redwood-model-variant in customer-facing logs so users can debug these incidents without heavy tracing.

olivia: confirmed explicit fallback_model: null fixed my local repro — vectors back to 768. I'll open a tiny doc PR to add the shape-assertion and mention the node parity caveat.

olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
